title: ruagea yungasana
intro: Ruagea yungasana, commonly known as Yungas root, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Ruagea yungasana include its anxiolytic, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ruagea yungasana include iridoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
